name: Confluence — Aug-Matched Dating Network
description: Confluence is GLMZ's dominant dating and relationship platform, built around the practical reality that physical and neural compatibility in an augmented society is genuinely complex — chrome-heavy users need partners whose bodies can tolerate proximity to strong EM fields, geneware aesthetics require partners with compatible preferences, and BCI intimacy requires handshake protocols that not all implants support. Founded in 2208 by the synthetic-human duo Petra Osei-Lindqvist and the Synthetic designated Seven-Canticle, Confluence runs a deep compatibility engine that cross-references aug loadouts, BCI firmware versions, geneware profiles, and self-reported preference data. The platform explicitly refuses to filter by tier, though its premium features are economically Tier 3+ accessible.
cultural_impact: Confluence has normalized open discussion of augmentation compatibility as a legitimate dimension of intimacy, and its annual 'Confluence Report' on M88 relationship trends is cited by sociologists, urban planners, and corponation HR departments alike.
locations: Confluence HQ, Tier 3 commercial block near the Old Navy Pier remnant
Seven-Canticle's design studio, Tier 2 synthetic district
Confluence community meetup spaces in Ward 4 and Ward 9
story_hooks: A series of Confluence-matched dates ends in the matched parties going missing — the compatibility algorithm has been compromised to route specific aug profiles toward an unknown collector

Seven-Canticle begins advocating for Synthetic-only matching profiles on Confluence, fracturing the platform's community between those who support synthetic dating autonomy and those who call it segregation
A Tier 1 user with salvaged, mismatched chrome is using Confluence's free tier to find connections — their profile keeps getting algorithmically suppressed, and they're starting to understand why
user_base: 890,000 active users; notable for highest synthetic user percentage of any mainstream platform at 12%, and significant Tier 1-2 free-tier presence
monetization: Freemium subscription model, premium compatibility depth scans, aug-profile verification badges, anonymous matching for users who don't want tier data visible
notable_feature: The BCI Handshake Protocol checker — a pre-date tool that lets users safely test neural intimacy compatibility before physical meeting, developed by Seven-Canticle and now licensed to medical providers
